entries.name: AURORA_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: The client ID of a Flute (Aurora Payments) API key made for KaratOS. Flute uses it with the secret to hand out a short-lived token.
howToGet: Signed in to the Flute dashboard, open Merchants, choose the business, then API Keys, and create a key named KaratOS.

Where the business is under a partner, ask the partner to allow the key only List Transactions, Get Transaction Details and Get Settlement Batches. A merchant's own key can reach every endpoint; the connector sends only those reads.
Flute shows the secret once. Copy both straight into the host's secret store. Never paste them into chat or an issue.

entries.name: AURORA_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: The client secret of the same Flute API key. It goes only to Flute's OAuth server.
howToGet: Shown once, with the client ID, when the API key is made.

entries.name: AURORA_ENVIRONMENT
entries.description: Optional. production for the business's own Flute account, or sandbox for a Flute sandbox account. Defaults to production.
howToGet: Leave it unset for the business's own account.
